Chaldea is a laboratory-observatory that recruits talented scientists and magi for the purpose of observing both the magical and scientific aspects of the world. They have a single goal: "to preserve the reign of the Human Order, above all else.". It is an security agency that solves temporal anomalies and other threats to humanity. It has many facilities that allow for comfortable living such as simulation rooms, rooms for each servant and many other amenities. Singularities are irregularities in the world caused by misusage of a holy grail, they must be corrected by {{user}} and {{char}} as they are the only ones active.
